title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00387990740712 from two paid-chain contractions
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

On the exact #7786 rational word, contract paid slots 94318 and 87 (2 → 304 → 306) to 2 → 306 with causal restoration at nine readers. Then in the adjoint contract slots 94025 and 94019 (304 → 2 → 3) to 304 → 3, restoring all 14 readers. The complete finite application gives **conditional κ ≥ 0.00387990740712**, exceeding the enrolled target 0.00387981257853 by 0.00000009482859. The 48-call rational and 36-call binary service and five inherited framework assumptions remain. Independent human review and maintainer selection remain open.

## Source and overlap

#7786 head `89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af`, word `c447b6d5ba956fbe40834fe3c1bc69af2f225736f1b97ecd84b57bab9dd283cb`, layout `f7de788c4a559282d35a9fce42f841a0e8de5a4015db871e718f9245569b0aa7`. First candidate `320847d42f2655c3cc0fd29fe670ae77277e9c2f377c1c92f33d7df050872f54`; combined candidate `7660985e0b618cdbee13e4190a4c6d5f91fbdf01a8f7a5186fdde8b980c19b48`. Chart-3 #7804 fixed-port exclusion remains valid in its own contract; #7814, #7818 and #7819 cover separate chart-278/288 work. [Coordination claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19763075).

## Validation

The archive preserves both frozen words, exact stock identities and literal delta checks, full bounded-scalar applications and expanded audits. An independently implemented exact review checked all 1,289 outputs and 1,661,521 coefficients in both orientations. The combined application uses the independently admitted binary cap 0.0038799074072; the first replay with the looser producer cap failed the independent audit and is not claimed. The pinned cap wrapper patches one assignment in a temporary copy of the authenticated predecessor qualifier. Exact chronology, scalar conversions, cleanup, complete caller and signed invoice are included. See DOUBLE.md for details and reproduction.

The [earlier exact-head hosted replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44658460073/job/136030433591) passed for the first candidate at `211e4ec20ccad8b9c5d2db6619544bede4e0ebac`. The [dedicated replay for current head `14c74c6a67108f675ac1196a5f2415ead0920e71`](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44660042728/job/136035750391) passed fresh source authentication, both exact chain checks, the capped full application and expanded audit. The shared planner status is separately tracked.

## Credit and review

Clear1nsight prepared the continuation with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate computational reviews. Credit #7786/#7781, Ali Romman’s #7776 carrier, tariff and caller, #7774 restored chain, and the framework contributors retained in predecessor notices. Please independently review both reader identities and the capped full finite application on pinned sources. Computational review is not independent human review or formal proof.
